cases.obligation: Every provider call is answered exactly once before the projection is handed on.
The prompt tells a change in the tool names it snapshotted, and another run's snapshot of the same roster is the same fact.
A provider request carries the exact generation fields and keeps no state on the wire.
An approval names the tool and the arguments of the one call it settled.
A rule minted from a decision covers what it came from and nothing beside it.
A handle resolves only through the generation that minted it.
A transaction staged from a replaced generation is refused.
An admission is reachable only through the generation that minted it.
Transformed arguments are revalidated before sensitivity or authority is read from them.
A source refresh changes only later admissions, and each generation runs once.
Attaching files to a tool result takes the proof that the call was permitted.
Code outside the crate cannot issue a grant through `Grant::issue`.
Code outside the crate cannot build an approval through `Approved::new`.
Code outside the crate cannot build a `ToolAdmission` from its fields.
Code outside the crate cannot clone an approval to run it a second time.
A run context cannot be descended from outside the crate that mints one.
A run result cannot be invented by a caller that ran no run.
An approved effect journals one stable prepared, started and finished invocation.
The result budget is reserved before a parallel wave is admitted.
Simultaneous preparations cannot oversubscribe the requested ceiling.
A cleanup failure never hides the failure that required the cleanup.
Repeated disposal reuses the first outcome instead of repeating the effects.
Encoded output is bounded after the output guard and before the event.
Nothing a command left running is still running after an early return from it.
An expired rotation is refreshed and written down before it is used.
A refresh cannot move a live credential scope to another account.
A written key appears in no debug output anywhere.
A variable Crucible was started with reaches no command unless the list names it.
An extension's own words cannot be printed as Crucible's.
A path outside the workspace is refused without reading it.
A link retargeted after the verdict leads outside and is refused.
Descriptor descent refuses an intermediate symlink.
A denied program reached through a shell is bounded by confinement instead.
A denied network target is never dialed, and the private proxy is the only route out.
The compatibility matrix is complete and never claims kernel confinement it does not have.
Invocation recovery distinguishes all three crash windows.
Resume refuses an expired approval that has not executed.
Obsolete checkpoint formats are rejected without compatibility aliases.
Resume refuses a live sandbox backend weaker than the one the session recorded.
Every pending outcome survives stop and resume with one provider result.
The shipped agent stands under the definition the wiring asked for.
An agent's instructions reach the definition only through the call that keeps the difference between none and empty.
A window narrowed mid-session redraws what is live at the new width.
Login and model selection keep keys off the screen.
A resumed session redraws the whole conversation and its compaction marker.
Every argument-only invocation answers the same text, on the same stream, with the same exit code.
Every built-in tool advertises the same name, schema text, effect, scheduling and ceilings.
Layered configuration resolves to the same values, and a workspace layer is refused the same widening keys with the same words.
The prompt-cache policy resolves to the same ceiling, the same source per field, and the same refusal when a workspace layer reaches past it.

The installed-extension sweep reads the same manifests in the same order, refuses the same ones with the same words, and refuses a directory over the ceiling whole rather than answering from part of it.

A session writes down the same record of the same turn: the same lines, in the same order, with the same fields — the conversation, the versioned framework companion beside it, and the bounded summaries a continued session reads to rebuild what was sent.

Every provider puts the same bytes on the wire for the same conversation: the same address, the same headers, and a body whose keys, order and shape have not moved. With a cache plan attached it also puts the same marker in the same place, over two turns, and gives the same account of what it encoded.
A printed server record names its environment and shows nothing of what it was set to.
A printed document shows nothing of a variable or a key argument written under a server, as it shows nothing of a variable written at the top.
Code outside the crate cannot build a vendor's provenance for a result except through the bounded constructor, so no restriction sentence or vendor name past its bound reaches a transcript or a log.

Every corpus answer is named once, ends with the line a case waits for, and is reachable under its own name.
A table drawn at 60 columns and narrowed to 30 draws exactly the rows the same answer draws at 30 columns from the start.
In native mode, a table narrowed once the window settles is written again as the rows the same answer draws at the new width from the start.
Every corpus answer resized to each width from 8 to 160 columns, from 160 and from 8, keeps the rows it draws fresh at that width, and none is wider than the width it is folded at.
While a formula is held the window shows the one row `◇ drawing a formula · 2 lines so far` and none of its source, and once it closes that row is gone and the formula is drawn.
In native mode a held formula shows the same one status row and none of its source, and once it closes and is sealed the row is gone and the formula is in the scrollback.
Display math, a mermaid fence and a diff fence each held past its cap are handed on as no block, and what is drawn is exactly the answer as written.
A record filled with tables lets the oldest go with its source before it holds the ceiling's count of them, stays within the ceiling, and charges exactly what each kept line weighs.
Every answer in the cut fixtures, held kinds included, draws the same rows however its text is cut into deltas.
